newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Telecom up on Korea Telecom deals.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Telecom up on Korea Telecom deals.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's Daewoo Telecom Co Ltd rose 560 won to their upper limit of 9,960 by midday on Wednesday.
Brokers said the shares were boosted by Daewoo's position as a Korea Telecom equipment supplier.

Late on Tuesday, Daewoo Telecom and Korea Telecom were named as leading candidates for setting up a $105 million joint venture with the Uzbekistan Telecommunications Ministry and state-owned Uztelekom to modernise Tashkent's telephone system.
"Daewoo has won as a Korea Telecom supplier. That is the core reason driving the shares," said Casey Choe of UBS Securities.
